description: Is this store running Meta ads? Finds the Facebook page behind a store domain and returns advertising since, live ads, trend (new, scaling, stable, stopped), channels and store platform. Signed in: catalog size, price range, recent launches and store age (free plan: 5 new domains a day); Pro and up also get recent ads. Unknown domains are checked live in the Meta Ad Library, within a daily limit.

domain.description: The store's domain, e.g. brand.com. A URL works too.

name: lookup_brand
title: Look up a brand
